author: Sanjeev NC
text:
Whenever a "bad habit" gains popularity, our immediate friends and family step in to police and shame us. With doomscrolling, no one has the moral authority to police doomscrollers.

Parents cannot tell kids to stop doomscrolling because they can't stop doomscrolling.

Parents cannot tell grandparents to stop doomscrolling because they can't stop doomscrolling.

Friends obviously cannot stop each other because that's how they stay in touch. 

Add to it the pretext of "I'm only using it for useful things". The cons heavily outweigh the pros. It's not worth it to exchange hours everyday to learn from thinly veiled promotional content masked as learning content.

I don't see a way for anyone to fight the apps while carrying a smartphone with them. I don't see how anyone these days can survive without UPI/Google Maps/Uber, Ola.
